entities.name: The Guildpact
entities.description: An ancient, powerful self-enforcing spell and treaty that forms the basis of all Ravnican law and sets each of the ten guilds' place.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane across which the Guildpact reverberates.

entities.name: Azor I
entities.description: The lawmage who originally conceived of the Guildpact and authored its first draft; parun of the Azorius Senate.

entities.name: Signing of the Guildpact
entities.description: The event in which the Paruns pooled their magic to create a self-enforcing treaty.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: The Boros parun, second signatory of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: The Golgari parun, third signatory of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: The officer whose arrest of Szadek broke the Guildpact's spell.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: A Dimir leader who tried to destroy the Guildpact by taking control of other guilds.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The guild whose task under the Guildpact was to oppose it.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Drafted the non-magical New Accord of the Guilds of Ravnica.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who became the first Living Guildpact; he lost the ability when the Chamber of the Guildpact was destroyed.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Destroyed the Chamber of the Guildpact at the start of the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon whose spirit was used to reestablish the Guildpact and who became the second Living Guildpact.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war during which the Chamber of the Guildpact was destroyed.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which the second Chamber of the Guildpact was destroyed.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The Orzhov ghost council whose chamber is exempt from the Guildpact.

events.summary: The Paruns pooled their magic at the Signing of the Guildpact to create a self-enforcing treaty.
events.quote: During the Signing of the Guildpact , the Paruns pooled their magic to create a treaty that could enforce itself.

events.summary: Agrus Kos arrested Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact, exploiting a loophole that broke the Guildpact's spell.
events.quote: The Guildpact's spell was finally broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact

events.summary: Teysa Karlov drafted a non-magical new Guildpact that no guild took seriously.
events.quote: Since it was not backed up by metaphysical forces, no guild took it seriously.

events.summary: The Guildpact's magic was reestablished as a living being, Jace Beleren.
events.quote: The Guildpact's magic was later reestablished after the events of Dragon's Maze , but this time in the form of a living being: Jace Beleren .

events.summary: Nicol Bolas destroyed the Chamber of the Guildpact, causing Jace to lose his abilities as Living Guildpact.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas destroyed the Chamber of the Guildpact by summoning the Planar Bridge within it

events.summary: A ritual with representatives of the ten guilds and Niv-Mizzet's spirit reestablished the Guildpact and revived Niv-Mizzet as a new Living Guildpact.
events.quote: the Guildpact was reestablished through a ritual using representatives of the ten guilds and the spirit of Niv-Mizzet

events.summary: The second Chamber of the Guildpact was destroyed during the New Phyrexian Invasion, but the Living Guildpact's powers held.
events.quote: The second Chamber of the Guildpact was destroyed during the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: On Ixalan, Jace used the Guildpact to force Azor to spend the rest of his life in solitude.
events.quote: Even on Ixalan , Jace could force Azor to spend the rest of his life in solitude

relations.quote: Originally conceived of by the lawmage Azor I
Agrus Kos arrested Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact

relations.note: Bolas's attack stripped Jace of the Living Guildpact abilities.
relations.quote: Jace lost his abilities as the Living Guildpact and was thus unable to wield its hieromancy against Bolas.
